critical_gaps: 1. Complete absence of RIAS (Risk Identification & Assessment System) in code, proto, and models.
2. Complete absence of TCED (Threat/Call Evaluation & Decision Engine) to fuse LID, Deepfake, and Risk signals.
3. No API Gateway or Orchestrator service to fan-out audio to LID, DSR, and RIAS concurrently and aggregate results.
4. Regional detector VMs (VM2-VM6) are non-executable scaffolds without models, entrypoints, or Dockerfiles.
5. Missing 19-language LID classification head on XLS-R 300M (currently limited to 10-class Open-Vakgyata benchmark).
6. VM7 AASIST-L threshold is uncalibrated (calibrated: false), with no empirical operating point determined on real datasets.
7. Missing final Android response schema / contract.

what_rias_should_not_duplicate: Do NOT implement LID or language classification (owned by VM1_LID)
Do NOT implement Deepfake/spoof voice detection (owned by VM2-VM7)

what_rias_should_consume: Raw audio stream / chunks (PCM/WAV) and/or decoded conversational transcripts
Call session metadata (caller ID, call duration, chunk sequence index, caller history)
what_rias_should_produce: Risk score [0.0 - 1.0], risk category (e.g., URGENCY_SCAM, OTP_THEFT, IMPERSONATION, EXTORTION), severity level, risk indicators, and explanation tags
what_tced_should_consume_from_rias: RIAS risk score, fraud category, and severity level combined with LID language/group and Deepfake spoof score
